comparison.objective: Set a telescoping luggage handle to a marked working length and leave its spring pin locked; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Unlocking and translating telescoping rails until a pin re-engages versus coaxial driver/wrench seating and countertorque during jam-nut locking.
comparison.success_condition: Usable marked length, pin engagement, hands withdrawn, and a two-second hold; exact length tolerance and score tiers are absent. Candidate additionally requires repeated retained actuation.
comparison.reason: The shared adjust-and-lock abstraction is generic; indexed linear translation with a spring pin tests a different ability from coupled threaded adjustment and counterholding.
